requires: UV, bake, material, LOD, collision, socket, export, and evidence plans
transforms, pivots, units, axes, hierarchy, and naming
LOD, collision, socket, and material-slot candidates
recorded export settings and exact candidate identity
recorded import settings and target build
representative lighting, camera, mip, and LOD observations
separate runtime, performance, collision, gameplay, animation, art, and rights statuses

evidence_surfaces.proves: The exact editable candidate can be reopened and inspected.
evidence_surfaces.does_not_prove: Export, runtime, performance, gameplay, art-direction, or rights acceptance.

evidence_surfaces.proves: Declared geometry, UV, naming, transform, format, or budget checks passed for the exact candidate.
evidence_surfaces.does_not_prove: Visual quality, representative runtime behavior, or gameplay fitness.

evidence_surfaces.proves: No named visible defect was observed in the sampled views and states, or a named defect was observed.
evidence_surfaces.does_not_prove: Unobserved views, performance, collision, deformation, gameplay, or rights.

evidence_surfaces.proves: The exact candidate imported or behaved as recorded in the named target build and configuration.
evidence_surfaces.does_not_prove: Other engines, platforms, versions, scenes, or professional acceptance surfaces.

evidence_surfaces.proves: Named metrics were measured under the recorded target context.
evidence_surfaces.does_not_prove: Global scene budgets, visual equivalence, or player experience outside that context.

evidence_surfaces.proves: Named interaction, collision, readability, placement, or use behavior was observed in a representative test.
Sources, terms, authorship, consent, attribution, and review state are recorded.
evidence_surfaces.does_not_prove: Legal clearance unless the owning authority explicitly supplies it.

adopted_research_boundary: Primary engine and format documentation defines target-specific pipeline constraints but does not reconstruct artistic judgment or prove game readiness. Budgets are project- and context-specific; no universal polygon, texture, material, bone, collision, or LOD thresholds are encoded.
known_gaps: No representative real-asset execution has yet proven the package.

Character, creature, foliage, vehicle, weapon, photogrammetry, cloth, destruction, procedural-generation, and virtualized-geometry depth remain asset-class extensions rather than silently claimed mastery.
No cross-intelligence body-versus-baseline comparison has been run.
No target-engine-specific automation or deterministic asset auditor is included in this package.
